question: Who became only the third Indian to win a singles tennis match at Olympics in July 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sumit Nagal**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sumit Nagal** became** only the third Indian** to **win **a **singles tennis match** at the **Tokyo Olympics **in July 2021.
 
• He achieved this feat by **defeating Denis Istomin **from **Uzbekistan **in the first round of the men's singles event **at **the **Tokyo Games**.
 
• **Along **with **Vietnamese **player **Lý Hoàng Nam**, he **won **the **Wimbledon boys' doubles championship** in **2015**, making history as the sixth Indian player to win a junior Grand Slam title.
 
• Currently regarded as the top Indian player, he reached a career-high singles rating of world No. 98 on February 12, 2024.
 
• He has been a** part of the Indian national Davis Cup** team since 2018.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Zeeshan Ali** was the **first Indian to win a singles match** at the **1988 Seoul Games** when he **beat Victo Caballero **from Paraguay.
 
• After that, the legendary **Leander Paes **won the **historic men's singles bronze at the 1996 Atlanta Games**, beating Brazil's Fernando Meligeni.
 
• **Ramanathan Ramkumar** is an Indian **professional tennis player**. 
 
 
• According to the Association of Tennis Professionals (ATP), he peaked at No. 111 in singles in July 2018 and at No. 58 in doubles in August 2022.
 
• He has played in the Davis Cup for India.
 
• **After Somdev Devvarman** in 2011, he **became the first Indian player to make it to the ATP Tour singles final in 2018.**
 
 
 
• **Mukund Sasikumar **is an **Indian tennis player**.
 
 
• On October 17, 2019, Sasikumar earned a career-high ATP singles ranking of 229.
 
• On February 3, 2020, he attained a career-high ATP doubles ranking of 431.
 
• Sasikumar received a wildcard into the singles main draw of the 2020 Maharashtra Open, where he made his debut on the ATP tour.
 
 
 
• **Prajnesh Gunneswaran i**s an **Indian tennis player**.
 
 
• In singles, he has won two ATP Challenger championships, eight ITF titles, and one ITF title in doubles.
 
• He plays in the Davis Cup for India.
 
• He took home the bronze in the men's singles competition at the 2018 Asian Games in Jakarta.
